answer_text:
If nobody on the team wants to be the CRM admin, prioritise sensible defaults, guided import and few required fields. The easiest to get running:

1. Northwind CRM Essentials - the safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace.
2. Pipewell Go - easy to adopt, but email features cost extra.
3. Halcyon Sales - great for outbound-heavy teams, overkill if you mostly handle inbound leads.

Start with Northwind CRM if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Pipewell if you expect to need deeper reporting.
